from copy import copy
import os

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/395-36/1_395-36_init.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)

main_ws = wb["Main unique ID"]
src_ws = wb["Result what i am getting"]

# Recreate the requested output sheet
if "MyResult" in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb["MyResult"]
out_ws = wb.create_sheet("MyResult")

# Helper to copy cell style
def copy_cell_style(src_cell, dst_cell):
    if src_cell.has_style:
        dst_cell.font = copy(src_cell.font)
        dst_cell.fill = copy(src_cell.fill)
        dst_cell.border = copy(src_cell.border)
        dst_cell.alignment = copy(src_cell.alignment)
        dst_cell.number_format = src_cell.number_format
        dst_cell.protection = copy(src_cell.protection)

# Collect IDs from Main unique ID sheet, preserving manual-input order
main_ids = [
    main_ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    for r in range(1, main_ws.max_row + 1)
    if main_ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value is not None
]

# Header from source result sheet
max_col = 15
for c in range(1, max_col + 1):
    out_cell = out_ws.cell(row=1, column=c, value=src_ws.cell(row=1, column=c).value)
    copy_cell_style(src_ws.cell(row=1, column=c), out_cell)

# Map existing rows by Unique ID
src_rows = {}
for r in range(2, src_ws.max_row + 1):
    uid = src_ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    if uid is not None:
        src_rows[uid] = r

yellow_fill = openpyxl.styles.PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFFFFF00")

# Build final result: all IDs from Main unique ID; blank yellow rows for missing IDs
for idx, uid in enumerate(main_ids, start=2):
    if uid in src_rows:
        src_r = src_rows[uid]
        for c in range(1, max_col + 1):
            src_cell = src_ws.cell(row=src_r, column=c)
            dst_cell = out_ws.cell(row=idx, column=c, value=src_cell.value)
            copy_cell_style(src_cell, dst_cell)
    else:
        for c in range(1, max_col + 1):
            dst_cell = out_ws.cell(row=idx, column=c, value=uid if c == 1 else None)
            dst_cell.fill = copy(yellow_fill)

# Match useful sizing from source sheet
for c in range(1, max_col + 1):
    col_letter = openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(c)
    out_ws.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = src_ws.column_dimensions[col_letter].width

# Ensure the output directory exists and save
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
